stem: Voltmarkt's CFO asks about Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices: "Of the subscription revenue we had from existing businesses a year ago, how much do we still keep, leaving any upgrades out?" Which calculation answers this question?

options.text: 100 × businesses lost in the month / businesses active at the start of the month
The sum of the monthly fees of every active plan this month
100 × cohort MRR now, upgrades included / MRR a year ago
100 × cohort MRR now, each business capped at its old MRR / MRR a year ago
